mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing the present value of future earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return following FEDFUNDS below 0.5% is negative or not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% over a 10-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both positive MoM
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS have positive month-over-month change over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%), strong job growth supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% over a 10-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 5-day forward return following INDPRO above 100 is negative or not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1200.0 thousand units signal a weakening housing market, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1200.0 over a 10-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) signal a restrictive monetary policy amid persistent inflation, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% over a 10-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong industrial expansion (INDPRO > 105), robust manufacturing output supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105 over a 10-year rolling window.
